items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 24 at 12:49AM PST until November 25 at 2:00PM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Tidal overflow flooding expected.

* WHERE...Central Coast of Oregon.

* WHEN...From 7 AM Tuesday to 2 PM PST Wednesday during periods
of high tide.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding, up to one foot above ground level,
during high tides is expected in the low lying areas near
bays, sloughs, and the lower reaches of the coastal rivers.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...For the Central Coast of Oregon, the total
tides at Newport (South Beach) will be 11.8 feet at 11 AM PST
Tuesday November 24, 12.1 feet at 12 PM (Noon) PST Wednesday
November 25, and 11.7 feet at 1230 PM PST Thursday November 26.
items.instruction:
A Coastal Flood Advisory means that tidal overflow flooding of
low-lying areas is expected dye to high tides. Coastal residents
in the warned area should be alert for rising water, and take
appropriate action to protect life and property.

items.headline: The Coastal Flood Warning has been cancelled.
items.description: The Coastal Flood Warning has been cancelled and is no longer in effect.
items.instruction:
A Coastal Flood Advisory means that tidal overflow flooding is
expected. Coastal residents in the warned area should be alert
for rising water, and take appropriate action to protect life and
property.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued November 24 at 12:34AM PST until November 25 at 7:00AM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Gale Warning, seas 18 to 23 ft at 15 seconds and
south winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 40 kt. For the
Hazardous Seas Warning, very steep and hazardous seas 17 to 22
ft at 16 seconds and south winds 20 to 30 kt expected.

* WHERE...Inner Coastal Waters from Cape Shoalwater to Florence
out 10 NM.

* WHEN...Gale Warning, until 7 AM PST Wednesday. Hazardous Seas
Warning, from 7 AM to 1 PM PST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
A Gale Warning means winds of 34 to 47 knots are imminent or
occurring. Operating a vessel in gale conditions requires
experience and properly equipped vessels. It is highly
recommended that mariners without the proper experience seek safe
harbor prior to the onset of gale conditions.
